facts.fact: StackAdapt's Data Science team has grown to roughly 62 people, split between machine learning engineers and applied machine learning scientists, over the past 12 years.
facts.quote: Over the past 12 years, our Data Science team has grown to roughly 62 people, split between machine learning engineers and applied machine learning scientists.

facts.fact: Three StackAdapt data science team members (Richard, Kuan, and Zeynep) have between them spent almost two decades building at StackAdapt.
facts.quote: who between them have spent almost two decades building at StackAdapt

facts.fact: StackAdapt describes itself as an AI advertising and orchestration platform that spans both programmatic and owned channels.
facts.quote: StackAdapt is an [AI advertising and orchestration platform](https://www.stackadapt.com/platform) that spans both [programmatic](https://www.stackadapt.com/resources/blog/what-is-programmatic-advertising) and [owned channels]

facts.fact: StackAdapt's lookalikes project identifies users who resemble customers who have already converted for a given advertiser, and runs an automated training pipeline that retrains a model per advertiser.
facts.quote: It isn’t powered by one hand-tuned model—it runs on an automated training pipeline that regularly retrains a model per advertiser.

facts.fact: StackAdapt states that it does not have a deterministic, logged-in identity for ad targeting, and that it is harder to observe what its ads actually caused.
facts.quote: We don’t have a deterministic, logged-in identity for targeting, and it’s harder to observe what our ads actually caused.

facts.fact: According to StackAdapt's data scientist Richard, the work of the data science team is divided into three buckets: defining the problem, preparing the data, and putting the model into production.
